title: docs(adr): amend ADR 0028 now that the review script and its tests are gone
body:
## Summary

Addresses the agent review on #394: ADR 0028's Consequences still said `bun test ./scripts/` (in `check-workflows`) runs the copied review script's tests. Since 534d6c98 the copy and its tests are gone, and #394 removed the step.

ADRs are append-only, so this adds a dated **Amendment** section (the same shape as ADR 0010's) instead of rewriting the line, and links it from the Status row. The Status row also drops "not yet run in this repository": the agent review ran on #394 and #395 on 2026-10-27.

Docs only. Pushed with `LEFTHOOK=0`: the pre-push hook type-checks the desktop app, and this worktree has no `node_modules`. `oxfmt --check` passes on the file.

## How to test it yourself

1. Open `apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx`, or run `bun run dev` in `apps/documentation` and open ADR 0028.
2. The Status row says it first ran on PR #394 and links "amendment".
3. The link jumps to "Amendment: the review script and its tests left this repository" at the end. The original Consequences line is unchanged above it.
